~Fire Burst~.Effect:
Deal 1d10 Fire Damage to a Unit.
If it had already taken Fire Damage this Combat, its hit by another 1d10 Fire Damage.
~Fire Burst~.Upgrade: The extra Damage counts separately for Pyromancy.
~Fire Burst~.EffectGreen: Critical Strike - for each 10 rolled, apply a Combo.

~Burning Breath~.Effect: All Units 3x3 meter area take 1d6 Fire Damage.
~Burning Breath~.Combo: If any affected Unit has a Combo, +50% total Damage (to all Units) and does not trigger the Cooldown.

~Searing Arrows~.Effect: Shoot 3 rays of fire (at one or more Units). Each does 1d10 Fire Damage.
~Searing Arrows~.Notes: You can roll them one by one, after they deal the Damage.

~Fire Enchantment~.Effect:
Choose a metallic weapon to imbue it with Fire.
That weapon deals +1 Damage (or +1d4 for 2-handed weapons) and the total Damage becomes Fire Damage.
~Fire Enchantment~.Upgrade: Lasts until the end of the next (or current) combat, or the end of the Adventure.
~Fire Enchantment~.Notes: Does not stack with other weapon enchantments from Spells.

~Cinder Storm~.Effect: All Units exactly 2 meters away from you take 2d4 Fire Damage and become Dazed or Blinded (your choice).

~Blazetrail~.Effect: A Unit you can see gains propulsion by fire. It gains +3 Movement Speed and whenever it comes near a Unit, that Unit takes 1d4 Fire Damage.
~Blazetrail~.Upgrade: The Damage also happens the moment you cast this Spell, around the target Unit.
~Blazetrail~.Notes: The Damage can only happen once per Turn per Unit. The Damage source is you (for amplification effects).

~Fire Ball~.Effect: All Units in 6x6x6 meter area take 6d8 Fire Damage.
~Fire Ball~.Notes: Cover is calculated from the center of the area.

~Flame Ward~.Effect:
An ally you can see becomes surrounded in a fiery aura.
The next time they take Fire Damage, they take -100% Fire Damage, and that Damage is dealt to all Units within 1 meter of it.

~Ignition~.Effect:
Ignite a Unit you can see. At the end of each of your Turns, it takes 8 Fire Damage.
Its ignition ends if the Unit is Damaged by Cold, Shock or Acid or is splashed with water.

~Lightning Chord~.Effect:
Create a lightning chord between you an a Unit.
At the end of your every turn, deal 1d6 Shock Damage to it.
~Lightning Chord~.Upgrade: The chord is broken if you end your Turn more than 5 meters away from it.
~Lightning Chord~.Notes:
A Unit can only be affected by one Lightning Chord at a time.
You can have multiple Units chorded at a time.

~Charge Ward~.Effect:
An Ally you can see (or you) becomes surrounded in an electric aura.
They gain 1d6 Shielding. When it breaks, deal that much Shock Damage to all Units within 1 meter of the Ally.

~Conduit Flow~.Effect:
Choose a Worthy Unit other than you. If Enemy, it takes 1d10 Shock Damage. Otherwise, Heal it for 1d8.
If there is another Unit within 2 meters of it, repeat Conduit Flow on the new Unit (you choose if multiple).
~Conduit Flow~.Notes: Each Unit can be affected by Conduit Flow only once per cast. Cover is calculated from Unit to Unit (as if the conduit is jumping from Unit to Unit). The conduit can be repeated on you as long as you're not the first target.

~Electric Enchantment~.Effect:
Choose a metallic weapon to imbue it with electricity.
Whenever it attacks, also deal 1d6 Shock Damage to a different Unit within 3 meters of it.
~Electric Enchantment~.Upgrade: Lasts until the end of the next (or current) combat, or the end of the Adventure.
~Electric Enchantment~.Notes: Does not stack with other weapon enchantments from Spells. If targeting an Ally's weapon, this does count towards Wizard's Electromancy.

~Volt Guard~.Effect:
Use when a Unit would take Damage (after roll). Negate 50% of the incoming Damage and return it back to the source as Shock Damage.
Apply a ~Combo~ to either of them.
~Volt Guard~.Upgrade: The returned Damage is a quick lightning that bends around obstacles, ignoring Cover or Line of Sight.

~Chain Thunder~.Effect:
Strike an Enemy with Lightning for 2d10 Shock Damage.
The lightning extends and strikes the closest _new_ Unit within 3 meters, dealing half of the previous damage.
This keeps on extending and striking new Units until it deals 0 Damage or there are no more Units to strike.
~Chain Thunder~.Notes:
This lightning can't strike the same Unit twice per cast (so it only hits _new_ Units that it hasn't hit).
If there's a tie for the closest Unit, you choose which Unit it hits.

~Elating Jolt~.Effect:
Choose a Unit you can see.
If your last cast Spell was shock-themed, they regain 1 Mana and get a Shielding that can block 1d8 Damage.
Otherwise it takes 1d6 Shock Damage and is Slowed.

~Ice Shard~.Effect: Throw an icicle at Unit, dealing 2 + ^Any Stat^ Cold Damage.
~Ice Shard~.Combo: Shoot another icicle into them for -50% Damage!

~Rime Shackles~.Effect:
Deal Cold Damage to a Unit equal to 1d6 + ^Its Dexterity^.
Slow it. Apply a Combo to it.
~Rime Shackles~.Notes: Slow stacks to Double-Slowed and Triple-Slowed.

~Deep Freeze~.Effect:
Choose a Unit you can see that has taken Cold Damage this Combat.
It takes 4d6 Cold Damage and is Single-Stunned.

~Frost Enchantment~.Effect:
Choose a weapon to imbue with Frost. All its dealt Damage becomes Cold Damage.
Each attack with it reduces the taarget's Movement Speed on its next Movement by 2.
~Frost Enchantment~.Upgrade: Lasts until the end of the next (or current) combat, or the end of the Adventure.
~Frost Enchantment~.Notes: Does not stack with other weapon enchantments from Spells.

~Snowstorm~.Effect:
Choose a 4x4 meter area and a direction.
All Units caught in the area take 1d6 Cold Damage.
If they were already affected by a Crowd Control, Single-Stun them instead.

~Frostfall~.Effect:
Choose a Unit. It takes 1d10 Cold Damage, and each Unit within 2 meters of it takes Cold Damage equal to 200% of the rolled amount.
If there were no Units within 2 meters of it, the target is Triple-Stunned instead.
~Frostfall~.Upgrade: When Stunning a flying target, it remains stuck in the air (levitating) for up to 6 seconds.

~Iceberg Drop~.Effect:
Choose a 6x6x6 meter area.
Conjure a giant iceberg in the sky that you drop upon the area.
All Units hit are pushed to the closest available edge of the area and take 6d6 Cold or Smash Damage.
The iceberg remains in the area until it melts.

~Crystalize~.Effect:
Use when a Unit would take Damage.
Give it 2 Shieldings that can block 1d20 Damage each, and Double-Stun it.

~Magic Arrows~.Effect: Shoot 2 arcane arrows. Each does 1d4 Pulse Damage.
~Magic Arrows~.Combo: 1 more arcane arrow shoots from the target into any target within 5 meters of it.
~Magic Arrows~.Notes: When you cast this, decide the targets before rolling the dice. Roll the dice for each target at a time.

~North Star~.Effect: You conjure a magical star that always shoots North and deals 9d4 Pulse Damage to the first Unit hit.
~North Star~.Combo: The star explodes, dealing 50% of the total Damage to all other Units within 2 meters of the hit target.
~North Star~.Notes:
You can only shoot the star towards North - without an angle.
Ask the DM which way North is (if your character knows that).

~Magic Ward~.Requirement: Level 2, only usable in Worthy Combat
~Magic Ward~.Effect: Give an ally you can see one Shielding that can block 1d4 Damage.

~Longblade~.Effect:
Magically extend the weapon of a willing ally you can see (or yourself) to up to 3 meters.
Its Attacks with that weapon can have up to 3 meters range.

~Magic Arrow Barrage~.Effect:
Conjure floating arrows in a 3x3 area, up to 10 meters above ground.
At any point (for 0 Actions or with a Reaction), you can release these arrows downward. All Enemies hit take 3d4 Pierce Damage.
~Magic Arrow Barrage~.Upgrade: At the start of your every Turn, if the barrage is not yet released, it increases by 1 meter in size in all directions and gains 1d4 Damage when it will be released (up to +3d4 and 9x9).
~Magic Arrow Barrage~.Notes:
E.g. every turn, it goes from 3x3 to 5x5, then 7x7, then 9x9, etc and deals from 2d6 Damage to 2d6 + 1d4, then 2d6 + 2d4, etc.
The arrows disappear as soon as they hit ground, or when dismissed (all at once) for free at any point, or after 1 minute of staying in the air.

~Arcane Prison~.Effect: Each Unit within 2 meters of you takes 2d4 Pulse Damage and becomes Dazed and Slowed.

~Ray of Annihilation~.Effect: Shoot a massive beam of pure arcane energy onto a Unit, dealing 11d6 Pulse Damage.

~Afterflash~.Effect: Choose a Unit. It takes 4d4 Shock Damage and teleport it up to 6 meters away.
